data.one_liner: Plugin to programmatically enable Bluetooth in Flutter apps
data.what_it_does: BluetoothEnable allows an app to request turning on Bluetooth and optionally show a custom dialog. It returns a string indicating success or failure.
use_when: When an app needs to enable Bluetooth without user navigating to settings
When a custom alert is desired before enabling Bluetooth
When targeting Android 13+ for Bluetooth activation
avoid_when: When only needing to check Bluetooth status
When building a full Bluetooth communication stack
strengths: Simple API with Future returning result
weaknesses: Only enables Bluetooth, no status or scanning APIs
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec, import package, call BluetoothEnable.enableBluetooth or customBluetoothRequest
